brief.users: quality engineers using the dashboard to compare cycle time with downtime hours across shift.
goals: Identify deviations in cycle time from the comparison baseline across shift for resource allocation during the annual portfolio review under policy changeover conditions in the current planning horizon. Include downtime hours as a companion KPI for the same decision.
brief.constraints: Refresh the dashboard daily and preserve accessible text and color contrast. Interpret the view for the policy changeover condition within the current planning horizon. Use MAX aggregation for cycle time. Bin production date at day grain and keep the time axis chronologically ordered. Sort the displayed cycle_time_minutes values ascending. Show no more than the top 9 categories after aggregation.

layout.hierarchy: Place cycle time first; place downtime hours after it as supporting context.
layout.layout_rationale: The 2 mapped views follow the brief KPI order, with the primary bar before the supporting view(s).
layout.reading_order: primary KPI before supporting KPI views

styling.color_palette: diverging blue-orange scale centered on the comparison baseline
styling.semantic_color_policy: Use color direction only for the encoded deviation from the baseline; no unencoded status is implied.
styling.record_specific_basis: Styling follows the bar encoding for cycle time and the available series fields.
styling.number_format: cycle time: duration in minutes or days with one decimal where needed; companion KPIs retain their own units.
styling.typography: Readable sans-serif hierarchy with explicit units and labels.
styling.contrast: WCAG AA contrast for text, marks, grid, and focus states.
styling.legend: No legend; a single accent is sufficient for the encoded metric.
styling.visual_hierarchy: Give cycle time the strongest visual emphasis and keep supporting annotations subordinate.
styling.decorative_policy: No decorative color or ornament is used when it does not encode a field in the brief.
styling.accessibility: Maintain WCAG AA contrast, direct-label important categories, and never rely on color alone.

interactions.purpose: Inspect the encoded dimensions and KPI fields needed to answer the stated goal.
Order cycle time minutes ascending as specified by the brief constraint.
Restrict the day-binned production date view to the period relevant to the stated goal.
Link the mapped views through shared production date selections.

rationales.claim: For the deviation objective, the bar mapping gives cycle time x=shift, y=cycle time minutes; every referenced field is present in the brief and the statement describes an encoding rather than an observed outcome.
rationales.principle: Bar length makes cycle time comparable across the encoded shift categories and keeps the ordering visible.

rationales.claim: For the comparison objective, the bar mapping gives downtime hours x=plant, y=downtime hours; every referenced field is present in the brief and the statement describes an encoding rather than an observed outcome.
rationales.principle: Bar length makes downtime hours comparable across the encoded plant categories and keeps the ordering visible.

rationales.claim: The layout puts cycle time first and keeps downtime hours in supporting blocks, matching the 2 mapped visual components in the brief.
